profile.headline: Software Developer with Expertise in Web Development & Testing
profile.summary:
I’m a software developer with years of experience working for IBM and other leading institutions with a focus on results and client-centric solutions. I am passionate about learning new technologies, thinking outside the box, and creating solid software through testing. 

With a proven record managing, testing, developing, and implementing applications, I leverage Agile software development to support teams and work towards common goals. Some of these have included process automation, supply chain tracking, cloud applications, and more.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
● Provided supply chain tracking and alerting services for the Business Transaction Intelligence team. 
● Utilized an Agile process to provide front-end capabilities in Java through Continuous Delivery in a 2-week cycle.
● Removed GDPR data from the blockchain by writing scripts. Assisted customer data migration, blockchain upgrade.
● Created manual and automated tests for features: Developed and executed test plans, as well as API performance testing. 
● Supported chaos testing exercise to practice troubleshooting. 
● Resolved customer support issues, responding to incidents with PagerDuty.
● Used Eclipse IDE, JMeter (test scripts), Insomnia (test verification), Jenkins (making/running tests).

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: ● Developed a class scheduling application with MySQL, JavaScript, & HTML displaying classroom availability for students & staff.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
● Created a file-transfer application for S/FTP/S servers based on Java.
● Leveraged Agile software development process to iterate builds of a distributed microservice for file transfer scheduling.
● Monitored and debugged the distributed microservice.

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
● Researched and developed software for the US Army Corps of Engineers, Engineer Research and Development Center (ERDC) on Big Data and Data Science. Programmed in Python, HTML, JavaScript, etc.
● Made a web-based data-analytics application for veterans suffering from PTSD. Used Python, Flask Web Framework, PostgreSQL as the backend database, BootStrap 3 for frontend, and JavaScript for dynamic content.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
● Supported software development for the CAPSTONE Prototype with the Computational & Information Systems Lab (CISL).
● Developed capstone of cloud-based platform for scientific data-analysis as a service, providing users a toolkit of reusable components (web-enabled micro-services). Enabled workflows for atmospheric data preparation and analysis.

organizations.name: Campus Activity Board
